url.description: Public web only (spec non-goals). No file://, no internal hosts. The pattern is the real check; format: "uri" is not evaluated without a FormatChecker.

why.description: What this source is expected to answer. Read by a human at the scope gate.

queries.description: The search strings the searcher reports having issued, AS REPORTED -- nothing in this process observes the WebSearch call, so this is the agent's own account of what it did and Appendix E says so. Required even when `sources` is empty: an empty search is exactly where a reader has to tell "the question is exhausted" from "we asked badly", and only the queries can. Without this no part of a run's literature search could be re-run or assessed for coverage, and the saturation halt was uninterpretable -- six dry tasks might mean an exhausted question or a monoculture of queries.

no_sources_reason.description: Required when `sources` is empty. Found-nothing and gave-up must be distinguishable, or the loop cannot tell which branch is exhausted.
